note: The CEC count site root. Opened 11/28 at 11:00 at vote.cec.gov.tw/2026-local/zh-TW/ (portal: vote.cec.gov.tw/home/zh-TW/; the old /zh-TW/ path answers 403). Page names keep the 2022 scheme (TC/SC/T1/T2/T3 + 17-digit codes); count pages appear when the site switches from its 'prior' to its 'count' stage. A different address can be set as "count_base" in data/live/outlets.json on the night branch: the poller picks it up within about 10 minutes, no restart.
note_start: The night runner can be started any time on the day (or the evening before); until start_reading (Taiwan time) it only checks one CEC page every 10 minutes.
